sentences.text:
Sunil Kumar Mandal & Ors vs The State Of West Bengal & Ors
on 5 February, 2026
Author: Hiranmay Bhattacharyya

Bench: Hiranmay Bhattacharyya
D/L- 8
05/02/2026
Ct. No.-19
Aritra Wpa 868 of 2026
 Sunil Kumar Mandal & Ors.
 Vs.
 The State of West Bengal & Ors.
 Mr. Amit Kumar Pan
 Ms. Tanusri Santra
 ....for the petitioners
 Mr. Subhasis Bandopadhyay
 ....for the State

The petitioners claim that several plots of land  within Mouza Butia under Police Station Budgebudge in  the District of South 24-Parganas, particulars of which  have been mentioned in paragraph 2 of the writ petition,
 were requisitioned vide case no. LA-II/1 of 1968-69 and  the possession of the same was also taken over.

The  petitioners allege that the aforesaid lands were sought to  be acquired upon publication of a notification under Section 4(1a) of the West Bengal Land (Requisition and  Acquisition) Act, 1948 on March 19, 1975.

sentences.text: He further submits that no  attempt was made to acquire the said lands by initiating  any proceeding under Section 9(3A) of the Land  Acquisition (West Bengal Amendment) Act, 1997.

He  submits that in the meantime, the 1894 Act stood repealed  2 and the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act,
2013 came into force with effect from 01.01.2014.

entities.text:
Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act,
2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: He further submits that since the properties of the petitioners have been utilized without paying any compensation, an appropriate proceeding under the 2013 Act is to be initiated.

Mr. Subhasis Bandopadhyay, learned advocate,
holding the brief on behalf of Mr. Soumitra Bandyopadhyay, appears for the State.

Let a report in the form of an affidavit be filed by the Special Land Acquisition Officer, South 24-Parganas,
being the respondent No.4, with regard to the allegations contained in the writ petition on or before February 20, 2026, upon serving an advance copy of the said report to the learned advocate for the petitioners.
Exception to the said report may be filed in the meantime.
List this matter on February 26, 2026 under the heading "For Orders".

(Hiranmay Bhattacharyya, J.)

 were requisitioned vide case no. LA-II/1 of 1968-69 and  the possession of the same was also taken over.

opennyai_summary.arguments:
Mr. Pan, learned Counsel appearing for the  petitioners submits that no award was declared within the Sunil Kumar Mandal & Ors vs The State Of West Bengal & Ors on 5 February, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/35946084/
1  stipulated time limit resulting in lapsing of the entire  acquisition proceeding.
He further submits that no  attempt was made to acquire the said lands by initiating  any proceeding under Section 9(3A) of the Land  Acquisition (West Bengal Amendment) Act, 1997.
He  submits that in the meantime, the 1894 Act stood repealed  2 and the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act,
2013 came into force with effect from 01.01.2014.
He further submits that since the properties of the petitioners have been utilized without paying any compensation, an appropriate proceeding under the 2013 Act is to be initiated.
Mr. Subhasis Bandopadhyay, learned advocate,
holding the brief on behalf of Mr. Soumitra Bandyopadhyay, appears for the State.
